evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/x is constructed from byte[][][] tile flags plus int[][][] tile heights, initializes the classic 99/104/104 terrain-region state and allocates the four-plane 104x104 overlay/underlay/shading/height working arrays.

Its public scene-build pass accepts the exact collision-map array and scene/world-controller object, walks four planes of 104x104 tiles, applies collision blocking, floor underlay/overlay color/light calculations and scene tile construction.
